messages:
amanda: Quick heads-up — I'm queuing a config-only deploy for east region routing + batching tweaks. No model change. Aiming to reduce tail latency and cost for short requests. deploy-bot will start canary once we confirm window.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued by amanda. change_id: cfg-20260320-17. Stage: canary (5% traffic). Planned start: 2026-03-20T18:00Z UTC.

amanda: Config diff (high level):
```
routing.policy: weighted -> latency-first
limits.max_concurrent_per_conn: 10 -> 6
timeouts.request_ms: 5000 -> 3000
batching.batch_window_ms: 50 -> 30
```
These are conservative reductions; no quantization or model pin changes.

raj: Are we pinning model versions for the canary so fallback is deterministic? what's the rollback trigger?

amanda: Yes — pin to model v2.1.4 for the entire rollout. Fallback plan: automatic fallback to v2.0.9 on per-host failures, full rollback manual if either: error_rate increase >= 5% absolute OR p95 latency spike > 800ms sustained for 5m. Also will abort if token-generation errors >= 0.5% for 10m.

mike_w: Can we add a gating metric for tokens/sec and tail latency? I want deploy-bot to pause if tokens/sec drops by >20% or p95 > 800ms. Also I'll set a temporary alarm for error_rate > 2%.

amanda: Good call. gating rules: error_rate > 0.02 OR p95_latency > 800ms OR tokens_per_sec drop > 20% will trigger immediate canary halt + drain. deploy-bot will log the reason to the thread.

tess: Heads-up — partner batch window runs 18:10Z-18:25Z. Recommend delaying start 30m to avoid overlap. @amanda

amanda: Ack. Pushing planned start to 2026-03-20T18:30Z UTC and updating canary window accordingly. Thanks for the heads-up.

deploy-bot: Schedule updated. New start: 2026-03-20T18:30Z UTC. Canary: 5% for 30m, then ramp to 10% for 20m if healthy, then 25% over 20m, full after confirmation. Gate checks applied.

raj: I'll watch the canary logs and perf for the first 45m. If we see noisier-than-usual p95 we'll consider rolling back to v2.0.9 and revert the routing policy.

mike_w: I'll open a temporary pager for the first 60m and post quick preflight commands to validate routing behavior: `curl -s http://deploy-check/api/health && curl -s http://metrics/api/query?expr=p95_latency`. Also adding a small synthetic that hits short requests (<=64 tokens).

amanda: Nice. Post-deploy rollout plan: canary -> increase if no gates tripped -> ramp to 100% by +2h if stable. Release notes draft entry: "cfg-20260320-17 — routing policy change to latency-first, reduced per-connection concurrency, tightened request timeout, and reduced batch window to lower tail latency and cost for short requests." I'll append observability links after deploy.

tess: If anything looks off during canary ping me ASAP. I'll postpone partner job if needed.

amanda: Appreciate it. starting manual prechecks at T-10. Will update this thread when the canary starts. :thumbsup:
